recall_prompt: Say how you would do this one — say how many terms the G.P. has, and how many values of r satisfy the equation you get.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Count the terms and find the common ratio
steps.margin_note: First mark. State that there are 5 terms. Both r = 3 and r = −3 satisfy r⁴ = 81, so both should be named here.
steps.memory_tip: Three means plus the two ends make five terms, so the last term carries r⁴.
lines: Inserting three geometric means between 1 and 81 gives 5 terms in G.P.
Here a = 1 and the 5th term is 81

recall.must_convey: That three means make five terms, so r⁴ = 81 and r = ±3.
accept: three means between two numbers make five terms
eighty one is the fifth term so r to the fourth is eighty one
r is plus or minus three
moodu means unte five terms, r power four equals eighty one
the fourth root of eighty one has two real values

steps.why: Five terms means the fifth term is ar⁴, so a single fourth power has to be undone. A fourth root of a positive number has two real values, and both are allowed here.
common_mistakes: Taking 81 as the 4th term and writing ar³ = 81.
Giving only r = 3 and missing r = −3.

steps.label: Write the three means
steps.margin_note: Second mark. The three values must be listed. Naming the second set as well shows that the ± was not dropped.
steps.memory_tip: From 1, multiply by 3 three times to reach 3, 9, 27, and one more 3 lands on 81.
lines: For r = −3: the means are −3,  9,  −27, and the 5th term is still (−3)⁴ = 81

lines.text: ∴ The three geometric means are 3, 9, 27  (or −3, 9, −27 when r = −3)

recall.must_convey: That the means are 3, 9, 27 for r = 3, and −3, 9, −27 for r = −3.
accept: multiply by three each time to get three nine and twenty seven
the means are three nine twenty seven
with r equal to minus three the means are minus three nine minus twenty seven
moodu tho multiply cheste three nine twenty seven vasthundi
both signs of r give a valid G P ending at eighty one

steps.why: Both sets are genuine geometric progressions from 1 to 81: with r = −3 the signs alternate, but the fifth term is (−3)⁴ = 81 all the same. The positive set is the one usually quoted.
common_mistakes: Listing 1 and 81 among the means, which gives five values instead of three.
Writing 3, 9, 27, 81 and calling it four means.
